intro_description: NTC-Mini is a smart digital Namaz time clock designed and developed by Wahda Tech for Masjids, offices, homes, and Islamic institutions. It displays daily Namaz and Sehri times, provides Azan reminders, and offers easy smartphone control through a web interface.
features: Premium design with a neat finish
Auto prayer times based on your location
Supports both Shafi and Hanafi methods
Easy Wi-Fi and mobile app control
